about: Neutral test cards for the bridge capabilities (scripts in mechanics/, tests in tests/core/test_bridge.gd and test_fight_rulings.gd). No tribe, no Bramble content.

cards.name: Piler
cards.text: When an adjacent friend attacks, this joins in.

cards.name: Burier
cards.text: Once a turn: put a shop unit in your heap.

cards.name: Tider
cards.text: Has +1 Attack per tide. When this dies, +1 tide for the game.

cards.name: Greeter
cards.text: Friends that enter get +1 Attack.

cards.name: Veteran
cards.text: After each fight, earn a medal (2 if this survived) and +1/+1 for each.

cards.name: Berserk
cards.text: While outnumbered: +{amount} Attack. Whenever this attacks outnumbered: +1/+1 for good.

cards.name: Driller
cards.text: At the end of your turn, this slot gets +1/+1.

cards.name: Seeder
cards.text: When this dies, add a copy of it to your heap.

cards.name: Swarm Mother
cards.text: When this dies, summon {count} Sprouts; they wait for room.

cards.name: Stepper
cards.text: After a friend in front of this dies, this steps into its slot.

cards.name: Plated
cards.text: Takes {amount} less damage from attacks.

cards.name: Officer
cards.text: Order (1): a slot gets +2/+2 and Taunt.

cards.name: Grower
cards.text: Start of Combat: +{amount}/+{amount} for each heap entry.

cards.name: Rooter
cards.text: The first time this dies, spend {cost} heap to return it.

cards.name: Charger
cards.text: Start of Combat: this attacks immediately.

cards.name: Raider
cards.text: Attacks the back row while it has units.

cards.name: Eater
cards.text: When you sell a unit, gain its stats for good; its death effects happen.

cards.name: Lancer
cards.text: Strikes first.

cards.name: Dirge
cards.text: Your death effects happen twice.

cards.name: Lender
cards.text: Adjacent units have Taunt.

cards.name: Slot Gift
cards.text: Give a slot +{amount}/+{amount}.

cards.name: Thorny
cards.text: Whenever this is attacked, deal {amount} damage to the attacker.

cards.name: Crier
cards.text: Whenever this attacks, +1 Attack. After this attacks, +1 Health.

cards.name: Slinger
cards.text: Instead of attacking, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
